records_artifact: build/fec-bulk-oppexp/2004/records.jsonl (gitignored and reproducible from the source URL, hash, identifiers, and checked-in parser)
interpretation: These are 27,862 reported rows, not 27,862 deduplicated payments. The 2004 file contains original, amended, and termination-report rows. Amendment-chain resolution, payee identity, beneficial ownership, and temporal overlap remain separate operations.
allowed_language: The official FEC 2004 operating-expenditure file contained 27,862 reported rows from six source-resolved George W. Bush presidential campaign committees under the checked-in cohort filter.

consumption.what_this_is: A reproducible, hash-pinned manifest of one official no-key FEC cycle-file scan against the complete pre-resolved cohort committee set.
consumption.what_this_is_not: A deduplicated transaction ledger, beneficial-interest match, crossing, or finding of wrongdoing.
consumption.copy_ready_caveat: The source includes amendment chains. Reported-row counts are not unique-payment counts, payee text is not resolved identity, and one cycle does not establish complete cohort coverage.
